title_en: Regulations on the Work of Government Counselors

articles.content_en: These Regulations are formulated for the purpose of regulating and strengthening the work of government counselors, ensuring that counselors perform their duties according to law, and giving play to the role of counselors in participating in the deliberation and administration of state affairs, offering suggestions and recommendations, consulting on national affairs, exercising democratic supervision, and conducting united front and friendship activities.

The counselor work institutions established by the State Council and the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government, and cities divided into districts shall be in charge of the counselor work of the people's government at the same level. The counselor work institution of a higher-level people's government shall guide the work of the counselor work institution of a lower-level people's government.

Counselors shall be appointed under an appointment system. Counselors of the State Council shall be appointed by the Premier of the State Council; counselors of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall be appointed by the governor, chairman of the autonomous region, or mayor, respectively; and counselors of the people's governments of cities divided into districts shall be appointed by the mayor.

Counselors shall be mainly appointed from among members of democratic parties and persons without party affiliation, and may also be appointed from among experts and scholars who are members of the Communist Party of China.

The term of office of a counselor shall not exceed five years. A counselor may be reappointed if the work of the government so requires and if the conditions prescribed in Article 5 of these Regulations are met.

If a counselor no longer meets the conditions prescribed in Article 5 of these Regulations or is unable to continue performing duties during the term of office, the counselor work institution shall promptly report to the principal responsible person of the people's government at the same level for dismissal.

A counselor may apply to the counselor work institution for resignation during the term of office. If a counselor applies for resignation, the counselor work institution shall submit the application to the people's government at the same level for approval.
A counselor shall perform work duties, observe work discipline, keep state secrets, comply with integrity rules, and shall not take advantage of his or her position to seek improper gains.

The people's government that establishes a counselor work institution shall provide financial guarantee for the counselor work of the people's government at the same level, and provide convenient conditions for counselors to perform duties according to law.

The people's government that establishes a counselor work institution shall, in light of the need for scientific, democratic, and law-based decision-making, arrange key tasks for counselors at the same level to carry out political participation and consultation work, regularly brief counselors on major government decisions, work arrangements, and economic and social development, directly solicit opinions and suggestions from counselors by means of symposiums, argumentation meetings, etc., and accept counselors' democratic supervision over government work.
The relevant departments of the people's government that establishes a counselor work institution and lower-level people's governments shall support and cooperate with the work of counselors, promptly handle counselors' suggestions, and provide feedback to the counselor work institution on the handling status.
The entity where a counselor's personnel relationship is maintained shall provide necessary working conditions for the counselor to perform duties, and implement the benefits prescribed by the state.

If the personnel relationship of a counselor is maintained in a Party or government organ or a public institution, the management of its staffing shall be carried out in accordance with the relevant provisions of the state.

If a counselor achieves outstanding results in counselor work and makes remarkable contributions to the scientific, democratic, and law-based decision-making of the government, the people's government at the same level shall give commendation and reward.

If a counselor fails to perform duties according to law or engages in activities inconsistent with the status of a counselor, causing adverse consequences, the counselor work institution shall report to the principal responsible person of the people's government at the same level for discharge.
These Regulations shall come into force as of January 1, 2010.
